about.badge: Est. September 2012 • Sher-e-Bangla Nagar, Agargaon, Dhaka
about.subheading: Bangladesh's Premier Tertiary Care Neuroscience Center
about.p1: National Institute of Neurosciences & Hospital started its journey from September, 2012. Officially inaugurated by the Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, it is situated in the health hub of Sher-e-Bangla Nagar, Agargaon, Dhaka. This is the only Govt. run tertiary care neuroscience center in Bangladesh.
about.p2: A 1000-bedded 10-storied hospital comprising specialized departments including Neurology, Neurosurgery, Pediatric Neurology, Pediatric Neurosurgery, Neurophysiology, Neurointervention, Neurorehabilitation, Neuroradiology, Neuropathology, Transfusion Medicine, Critical Care Medicine & a 100-bedded Stroke unit. Our Operation Theatres, Cath Lab, Laboratory Services, ICU & HDU are equipped with state-of-the-art sophisticated technologies.

stroke.heading: Recognize Stroke Symptoms: Think
stroke.subtext: Every minute counts in acute stroke management. NINS 100-Bedded Stroke Unit provides round-the-clock IV thrombolysis and mechanical thrombectomy.

F.title: Face Drooping
F.desc: Does one side of the face droop or is it numb? Ask the person to smile.

A.title: Arm Weakness
A.desc: Is one arm weak or numb? Ask the person to raise both arms.

S.title: Speech Difficulty
S.desc: Is speech slurred? Ask the person to repeat a simple sentence.

T.title: Time to Call NINS
T.desc: If someone shows any of these symptoms, call NINS 24/7 Hotline immediately!

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.subtext: Clear information about OPD serials, emergency stroke admissions, MRI tests, and visiting rules.

items.q: How can I book an Outpatient (OPD) ticket online at NINS?
items.a: You can book your OPD consultation serial online through our E-Health Patient Portal or by visiting the OPD Ticket Counter between 8:00 AM and 2:00 PM (Sat–Thu). OPD ticket fee is ৳10.

items.q: What is the Emergency Hotline for 24/7 Stroke & Trauma Patients?
items.a: For immediate emergency admission, call +880 2-9140752. NINS Emergency Casualty Ward and 100-Bed Stroke Unit operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

items.q: Are diagnostic tests like 3T MRI & CT Scans subsidized at NINS?
items.a: Yes! All diagnostic tests at NINS are conducted at government-subsidized rates (up to 70% lower than private diagnostic centers). Financially insolvent patients receive 100% free care upon Social Welfare approval.

items.q: What are the visiting hours for indoor wards and ICU?
items.a: Indoor Ward Visiting Hours: 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM daily. Neuro-ICU Visiting Hours: 5:00 PM – 5:30 PM (Only 1 attendant per patient permitted with Visitor Pass).
